defaultSeoDescription: Find and compare education consultancies in Nepal. Get study-abroad information, test-preparation guides and scholarship guidance.

name: Australia
summary: A popular choice for practical, internationally recognised education and a welcoming multicultural student experience.
introduction: Australia offers foundation, vocational, undergraduate and postgraduate pathways across major student cities. Nepalese applicants should compare course outcomes, total living costs and visa requirements—not only university rankings—before choosing a programme.

facts.label: Academic year
facts.value: Main intakes in February and July

facts.label: Popular cities
facts.value: Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide and Perth

highlights.title: Wide course choice
highlights.description: Choose from universities, pathway colleges and vocational providers.

highlights.title: Plan the full budget
highlights.description: Allow for tuition, accommodation, health cover, transport and daily expenses.

highlights.title: Check current visa rules
highlights.description: Entry and post-study settings change; verify them before applying.

name: Canada
summary: Known for respected institutions, diverse communities and programmes ranging from diplomas to research degrees.
introduction: Canada has universities and colleges across provinces with different climates, costs and employment markets. Focus on the institution’s status, programme relevance and realistic funding, and confirm current study-permit and post-graduation eligibility rules before committing.

facts.label: Academic year
facts.value: Common intakes in September, January and May

facts.label: Popular cities
facts.value: Toronto, Vancouver, Ottawa, Calgary and Montreal

highlights.title: University and college routes
highlights.description: Compare academic degrees with career-focused diploma options.

highlights.title: Province matters
highlights.description: Costs, weather and opportunities vary significantly by location.

highlights.title: Verify eligibility
highlights.description: Confirm programme and permit requirements on official sources.

name: United Kingdom
summary: Home to globally recognised universities, focused degrees and many one-year taught master’s programmes.
introduction: The UK offers a large range of undergraduate, postgraduate and pathway programmes in England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. Course length can be attractive, but students should compare tuition, city living costs, entry requirements and graduate outcomes carefully.

facts.label: Academic year
facts.value: Main intake in September; some January options

facts.label: Popular cities
facts.value: London, Manchester, Birmingham, Edinburgh and Glasgow

highlights.title: Focused programmes
highlights.description: Many degrees specialise earlier than comparable programmes elsewhere.

highlights.title: Shorter master’s options
highlights.description: A large number of taught master’s degrees take one year.

highlights.title: Budget by city
highlights.description: Accommodation and transport costs vary widely across the UK.

name: United States
summary: Offers exceptional academic variety, flexible degree structures and institutions in every type of setting.
introduction: US study options range from community colleges and liberal arts colleges to large research universities. Admissions, scholarships and testing policies differ by institution, so build a balanced shortlist based on academic fit, affordability and support for international students.

facts.label: Academic year
facts.value: Main intake in August or September; January also available

highlights.title: Flexible study
highlights.description: Many undergraduate programmes allow exploration before declaring a major.

highlights.title: Varied admissions
highlights.description: Each institution sets its own academic and testing requirements.

highlights.title: Funding opportunities
highlights.description: Research scholarships early and compare the final net cost.

name: New Zealand
summary: A compact, student-friendly destination with respected qualifications and strong links to applied learning.
introduction: New Zealand’s universities and institutes offer programmes in welcoming cities with easy access to nature. Students should evaluate programme accreditation, living costs, insurance and current immigration requirements before making an application.

facts.label: Academic year
facts.value: Common intakes in February and July

highlights.title: Recognised education
highlights.description: Qualifications span undergraduate, postgraduate and applied pathways.

highlights.title: Smaller study destination
highlights.description: A compact system can make comparing institutions more manageable.

highlights.title: Prepare early
highlights.description: Plan finances, accommodation and visa evidence well ahead of intake.

name: IELTS
summary: Build confidence across Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking for academic admission and migration purposes.
introduction: IELTS preparation works best when you first identify your required band score and test format. Combine timed practice with targeted feedback, especially for Writing and Speaking, and use official-style materials to become comfortable with the question types.

highlights.title: Know your target
highlights.description: Confirm the overall and individual band scores your institution requires.

highlights.title: Practise to time
highlights.description: Build accuracy first, then complete full sections under test conditions.

highlights.title: Get feedback
highlights.description: Expert review helps uncover recurring Writing and Speaking weaknesses.

name: PTE Academic
summary: Prepare for a computer-based English test that assesses integrated communication skills.
introduction: PTE Academic rewards clear communication, familiarity with the test interface and consistent performance across integrated tasks. Start with a scored diagnostic, learn how each task contributes to skill scores, and practise speaking naturally into a microphone.

highlights.title: Understand scoring
highlights.description: Prioritise tasks using official scoring information, not shortcuts.

highlights.title: Speak clearly
highlights.description: Practise steady pacing, pronunciation and microphone technique.

highlights.title: Review mistakes
highlights.description: Track repeated grammar, vocabulary and comprehension errors.

name: TOEFL iBT
summary: Develop the academic English skills needed to communicate in a university environment.
introduction: TOEFL iBT focuses on using English in academic contexts, including tasks that combine reading, listening, speaking and writing. Build note-taking and synthesis skills alongside language accuracy, then use full timed practice to develop stamina.

highlights.title: Integrated tasks
highlights.description: Practise combining information from reading and listening sources.

highlights.title: Academic vocabulary
highlights.description: Learn words in context rather than memorising isolated lists.

highlights.title: Timed responses
highlights.description: Use simple response structures you can execute under pressure.

name: SAT
summary: Strengthen Reading and Writing and Math skills for undergraduate admission where the SAT is considered.
introduction: Effective SAT preparation starts with checking whether your target institutions require or consider the test. Use a diagnostic to find content gaps, practise with the digital testing tools and review why every missed answer was wrong.

highlights.title: Close content gaps
highlights.description: Review core grammar, algebra, problem solving and data analysis.

highlights.title: Use official practice
highlights.description: Become familiar with the digital format and built-in tools.

highlights.title: Analyse every error
highlights.description: Separate knowledge gaps from timing and interpretation mistakes.

name: Kathmandu
summary: Explore education consultancies and study-abroad support in Nepal’s largest student services hub.
introduction: Kathmandu has Nepal’s widest concentration of education consultancies, language-test centres and application support services. Compare counsellor experience, university partnerships, fee transparency and after-enrolment support before choosing an office.

facts.label: Services
facts.value: Counselling, applications, test prep and visa guidance

highlights.title: Compare several offices
highlights.description: Ask each consultancy for a written breakdown of services and charges.

highlights.title: Verify claims
highlights.description: Confirm institutional partnerships and admissions advice independently.

highlights.title: Keep your documents
highlights.description: Retain access to your email, applications, receipts and original records.

name: Pokhara
summary: Find local counselling and test-preparation support without travelling to Kathmandu.
introduction: Pokhara offers a growing choice of education consultancies and language-test preparation providers. Look for advisers with experience in your destination and course, transparent processes and convenient access for follow-up appointments.

highlights.title: Ask about expertise
highlights.description: Choose advisers familiar with your intended country and study level.

highlights.title: Review the service agreement
highlights.description: Understand inclusions, refunds and third-party charges before paying.

highlights.title: Check student support
highlights.description: Ask what help continues after you receive an offer or visa.

name: Chitwan
summary: Compare accessible study-abroad guidance and preparation services in central Nepal.
introduction: Consultancies around Bharatpur and Narayangarh provide counselling, test preparation and application assistance for major study destinations. Evaluate the quality of the individual counsellor and documentation process rather than relying only on brand recognition.

facts.label: Services
facts.value: Counselling, test prep and application guidance

highlights.title: Meet your counsellor
highlights.description: Ask who will manage your case and how frequently you can get updates.

highlights.title: Demand transparency
highlights.description: Get realistic information about costs, timelines and admission chances.

highlights.title: Use official sources
highlights.description: Cross-check important visa and institution details before decisions.

name: Butwal
summary: Discover education advisers and test-prep providers serving students in Lumbini Province.
introduction: Butwal’s education-services market gives students in western Nepal local access to destination counselling and application support. Compare verified experience, communication standards and the total cost of services before selecting a provider.

highlights.title: Compare advice
highlights.description: A second opinion can reveal more suitable courses or institutions.

highlights.title: Understand all costs
highlights.description: Separate consultancy fees from university and official application fees.

highlights.title: Protect your access
highlights.description: Use your own contact details and keep copies of every submission.
